item.title: Anita Krishnan
item.description: I’ve raised funding, failed at a startup, succeeded at another, and mentored dozens of founders. But my most rewarding work? Watching a 12-year-old pitch a lemonade stand idea with more conviction than most MBA graduates.

item.title: Priya Sharma
item.description: I believe music isn’t about perfection — it’s about expression. When I teach kids, I don’t start with scales and theory. I start with a song they love. Once they hear themselves playing something familiar, the magic clicks.

item.title: Rahul Menon
item.description: Water is my second home, and I want every child to feel that same comfort. Too many kids in apartments grow up afraid of water — that doesn’t have to be the case when there’s a pool 50 meters from their front door.
